ForwardedHeaders.//Enabled: Set true only when the API is reachable solely through a trusted reverse proxy that overwrites X-Forwarded-For/Proto. Enabling it trusts all proxies.

Auth.//ResetCode: Emailed password-reset code: how long it stays valid and how many wrong guesses are allowed before it is retired.

Payments.//SigningSecret: Not committed. Set with: dotnet user-secrets set "Payments:SigningSecret" "..." --project src/AgroTrade.Api
Payments.//corridor: Task 2.4 ships one corridor. Widen only alongside a gateway that settles it.

Email.//Provider: Auto (default) uses Resend when Email:Resend:ApiKey is set, then SMTP when Email:Smtp:Host is set, otherwise the console sink. Force one with Resend, Smtp or Console.
Email.//Host: Blank keeps the console sink (emails print to the log). Set Email:Smtp:Host to switch to MailKit/SMTP; FromAddress then becomes required.
Email.//Credentials: Set Email:Smtp:Username and Email:Smtp:Password with: dotnet user-secrets set "Email:Smtp:Password" "..." --project src/AgroTrade.Api

Resend.//ApiKey: Resend API key (re_...). Set with: dotnet user-secrets set "Email:Resend:ApiKey" "re_..." --project src/AgroTrade.Api
Resend.//From: The From address must be on a domain verified in Resend, otherwise the provider rejects every send.

BackgroundJobs.//Enabled: Recurring maintenance workers. The test host sets this false.

Cache.//Redis: Set ConnectionStrings:Redis to cache in Redis; otherwise an in-process memory cache is used.
